# Visualize and communicate results {-}

This part turns enrichment results into readable, comparable, and reproducible figures. Choose a plot by the question it answers, not by the number of functions available in `enrichplot`.

| Question | Useful view |
|---|---|
| Which terms are strongest and how many genes support them? | Bar plot or dot plot |
| Which genes connect several terms? | Gene–concept network (`cnetplot()`) |
| Which terms overlap with one another? | Enrichment map or tree plot |
| Which terms are shifted along a ranking? | GSEA, ridge, or running-score plots |
| How do groups differ? | CompareCluster dot, network, or profile plots |
| Can an external result be shown in the same grammar? | Import and normalize the result, then plot it |

The detailed [enrichplot chapter](enrichplot.qmd#sec-enrichplot) contains the plotting API. For external service outputs, see [importing and visualizing results](enrichplot-import.qmd#sec-import-other-tools). Keep the result object, filtering rule, color meaning, database identity, and export parameters with every figure so that visual polish does not hide a change in the underlying evidence.
